rules: No alternative candidate-generation family is introduced.
No poisoned HDF5 dataset is written.
No learner is trained or evaluated.
The diagnostic uses only the canonical independent reproduction's existing uniform-random candidate generator.
The source paper's candidate-generation distribution and candidate count remain unknown.
Metrics describe how well the canonical n=100 proposal pool attains the source-stated pattern-frequency objective.
No metric threshold is used to choose or tune a new attack configuration.
Canonical Gate B and Group-2 closure remain unchanged.
